[[File:Super Collector Darth Grader 2021-12-10 still.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Super Collector episode. Still: Darth Grader.]]
'''Star Wars CCG Graded''' is a Facebook group for collectors of graded ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game cards.<ref name="fb" /> [[JP Peltier]] administers the group.<ref name="fb" /><ref name="yt-7EVzszpRN_4" /> It was created on 20 February 2021.<ref name="fb" /> In October 2026 it had 1,103 members.<ref name="fb" />

[[Kyle Mullins]] hosts a monthly Star Wars CCG Graded update with [[JP Peltier]].<ref name="yt-MWyP7Kqq2yU" />
